notes: Exposure uses reanalysis at one representative point per district (ERA5/ERA5-Land via Open-Meteo); large districts are not uniform.

No adaptive-capacity indicator with all-India district coverage was available openly (NFHS-5 compiled CSV covers 341 districts), so this is an exposure + sensitivity index, not a full vulnerability index.
District polygons: geoBoundaries IND ADM2 (LGD, 2021). Districts created after 2021 are not split out.
Weather point = where people live (population-weighted centre) when that is > 15 km from the polygon's representative point; this matters in mountain and desert districts (e.g. Leh, Kachchh).
WorldPop age shares follow state-level age structures, so 65+ / under-5 shares vary little within a state.
In high mountains the reanalysis grid averages over surrounding peaks and reads colder than valley towns (e.g. Leh, Kargil); these districts rank low either way.
